'''Marcus's soldiers''' are a group of minor characters who appeared in ''[[M12|Arceus and the Jewel of Life]]''. Only three have speaking roles. They are voiced by ''Ryūmi Akiyama'', ''Hiroyuki Baba'' and ''Hiroshi Yamamoto''.

The soldiers first appear when {{Ash}}, {{ashfr}}, and [[Sheena]] are sent back in time by {{mov|Dialga}}. As they are the guards of the [[Michina Town|Michina]] temple, they quickly capture the group under the orders of their leader, [[Marcus]]. Marcus goes on to have his {{p|Bronzong}} use {{m|Hypnosis}} on all but Sheena, then ordering the soldiers to take the others away.

Another soldier is seen later, preparing food with the forced aid of a {{p|Chikorita}} and a {{p|Cyndaquil}}. He is interfered with by {{AP|Pikachu}}, {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}}, the [[Spiky-eared Pichu]], and a {{p|Totodile}}.

Another soldier is [[Tapp]], who guards Marcus's prison cell.

In the present day, the soldiers' old equipment is found in the ruins by {{TRT}}.
